text:
Maya: Planning a compact launch for the new tiny-refapp OSS starter: short launch post, one benchmark spotlight, and a live 30min walkthrough. Need landing copy, quick benchmark visual, tutorial checklist, and inbound form.
Ethan: I can do the benchmark visual + methodology blurb. Will need sample runtimes and model names.
Priya: I'll write the launch post and 3 social messages. Will include TL;DR, demo gif, and link to sandbox. Draft by Tue.
Maya: Inbound routing: single HubSpot list 'tiny_refapp_launch_2025', tag 'tiny_refapp'. Autoresponder should include sandbox + quickstart link.
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: demo site staged at https://staging.tiny-refapp.example
Ethan: For the benchmark narrative, propose 2 slides: cold vs warm, and batching impact. PNG + alt text provided.
Priya: Landing also needs a short reproducibility note and a link to the notebook. I'll add a small callout about hardware used.
Maya: Owners: Priya=post+social, Ethan=bench+assets, Maya=forms+event. Deadline: assets ready by Wed EOD. Meeting to review Thu 09:00 UTC.
Priya: Also suggest tagging the repo with 'launch-2025' and adding a CHANGES.md entry.
Ethan: Will mockup graphs in Figma and drop exports in the doc.
Maya: If no blockers, we proceed with planned cadence. :rocket:
